New() stamps the SubPageLink's value onto the new row AND runs that field's OnValidate trigger on it -- NewRecordAsync's ValidateFieldsInOnNewRecord branch, which has no setter anywhere in Ncl, so only a service tier could answer it. The runner stamps but never validates, so "No. Validated" stays at the same Init() default "Never Validated" sits at and the AreNotEqual fails with both sides False. The first assertion in the test (the stamp itself) passes, so what fails is specifically the validation. This is the ValidateFieldsInOnNewRecord half of #2551.
